reason: We have already decided to go into the new market and referrals and fairs won't fill the pipeline there in six months. The free 15-company list costs me nothing, and EUR 500 plus pay-per-meeting is a risk I can carry if the list looks like people I'd actually sell to.
objection: If they spam half the market in my name, or a German or Romanian buyer gets annoyed and complains about GDPR, our reputation there is burned before we even start. I also doubt 'qualified' meetings: a buying manager taking a call to be polite is not a real buyer.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are generic or wrong for our niche, or the reference client in a close niche turns out lukewarm, I walk away.
